PreToolUse.description: Inject .ai-docs/ check instruction into Explore agent context

PostToolUse.description: [observability] Log + run scratch reminder after Bash

hooks.prompt:
# hook:post-edit-lint
A file was just edited. Tool arguments: $ARGUMENTS

Your job:
1. Extract the file path from the arguments.
2. Scan .ai-docs/ frontmatter (Glob '.ai-docs/*.md') for files with patterns or keywords related to 'lint-command', 'linting', 'commands', 'dev-commands', or 'build-commands'. Read only the relevant sections (use line ranges from frontmatter).
3. If found, run the lint command on the modified file using Bash and report results.
4. If not found in .ai-docs/, check for common config files (package.json scripts, .eslintrc*, pyproject.toml, Makefile) and infer the lint command.
5. Report: list all lint errors/warnings with file:line references. If clean, say 'Lint: clean'.

PostToolUse.description: [quality] Run project linting after file edits; lint command discovered from .ai-docs/

hooks.prompt:
# hook:post-edit-simplify
A file was just edited. Tool arguments: $ARGUMENTS

Your job is to review the modified file for simplification opportunities.
1. Extract the file path from the arguments.
2. Read the file.
3. Scan .ai-docs/ frontmatter for patterns and anti-patterns relevant to this file's language/domain. Read only the relevant sections (use line ranges from frontmatter).
4. Identify: unnecessary complexity/nesting, violations of documented patterns, documented anti-patterns present, redundant code, poor naming.
5. Do NOT edit the file. Report findings only as clear action items.
6. If no issues, say 'Simplify: nothing to do'.

PostToolUse.description: [quality] Report simplification opportunities after file edits based on .ai-docs/ patterns
